articles.title: South Korea joins more than 30 jurisdictions restricting Polymarket access
articles.snippet: Regulators rejected Polymarket's defense regarding its P2P nature, arguing the platform manages market rules and facilitates crypto-based gambling activity.

articles.title: South Korea moves to block Polymarket over gambling concerns
articles.snippet: The Korea Media and Communications Commission said Polymarket’s structure and operations amount to illegal gambling despite its noncustodial design and smart contracts.

articles.title: Prediction Markets Give the Fed 74% Odds of Standing Pat in September
articles.snippet: Traders across Polymarket, Kalshi, and Myriad are leaning the same way: no change at the September meeting.
